title: fix(pm): check:adr-anchors declares its whole-tree citation scan, so dispatch-gates derives it for every card
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92Vt19B5bTPa1d6K7Nf4xkL)_

Fixes #34086

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:门禁 `check:adr-anchors` 在源码里声明「我读整棵树」(dispatch-gates 现有的 whole-tree-population 标记),派发工具 `dispatch-gates` 同步认得 `git grep` 这种全树读法;从此每张卡的 `--commands` 都会派出这个门禁。
- 为什么改:这个门禁用 `git grep` 扫全仓所有文本文件里的 `ADR-NNNN` 引用,却只声明了 4 个路径;改它们之外的文件时派发清单不点它,开发者本地全绿、CI 才红(PR #33975 就是一个 `scripts/pm/` 脚本里的测试字符串触发的)。
- 风险与回滚:只改三个工具脚本,不发布任何包。每张卡多派一条命令,实测约 11 秒。dispatch-gates 只在识别清单末尾追加一条,原有三条及其下标不动。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` 的 `collectCitations` 上方新标记行与自测 `live-scan-population-is-declared`;`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `REPO_ROOT_WALK_SPELLINGS` 第四条。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs | grep adr-anchors`,预期一行 `pnpm check:adr-anchors`(修复前零行)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(非受管面)。

## What changes

`check:adr-anchors`' third check (#6634) collects citations with `git grep --untracked -IonE …` and no pathspec, so it reads every tracked and every untracked-not-ignored text file. Its source spelled only four path literals (`docs/adr`, its own script and the two release-owned `CHANGELOG.md` files on its excuse list), so `dispatch-gates` placed the family by those alone and scored it `silent` for any other file. Measured on main f81e4b6c: 10,237 tracked files cite an ADR, 10,078 of them outside those literals; `--commands scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` derived 33 commands and not this one.

**Route: declare, don't narrow.** The whole-tree read is the point of the check (a citation nobody resolves rots wherever it is written), so the scan stays as it is. `wide-population` was also rejected: it keeps a family out of `--commands`, which is the opposite of the acceptance and of "a miss fails toward deriving more". The existing `whole-tree-population` marker (the channel `check:nul-bytes` and seven other families use) is the fit. No new declaration grammar.

| File | Change |
|:--|:--|
| `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` | The `// dispatch-gates: whole-tree-population -- …` line above `collectCitations`, with a note on why the scan is not narrowed. A live self-test case, `live-scan-population-is-declared`, holds the marker to the scan in both directions: a scan reading more than one top-level root needs the marker, and a marker over a one-root scan is red too. The live battery's floor moves 21 → 22 for that case. |
| `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` | `REPO_ROOT_WALK_SPELLINGS` gains limb D, `a \`git grep\` search of the tracked corpus`, appended after limbs 0–2 (unchanged). Without it the marker was REFUSED ("its own source carries no recognised repo-root walk … EXTEND REPO_ROOT_WALK_SPELLINGS"). The regex is held to the execFile shape (`'git'` then an argv array holding `'grep'`), so the system `spawnSync('grep', …)` over one named file in `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs` does not match. Out of the card's file surface: declared to the seat before the edit and approved, with the claim's surface amended. |
| `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` | Two fixture cases beside limbs A–C: limb D reads the execFile `git grep`; the system grep is not a walk. |

## Tests

- `node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs --self-test`: 134 assertions pass, floor included.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier): 2207 cases pass, 335 s.
- Acceptance, before and after: on f81e4b6c `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` printed 33 lines, 0 naming `check:adr-anchors`; on a6876cc8 it prints 34, including `pnpm check:adr-anchors`, placed under "Always runs (declared population)" with the marker's reason. The always-runs block grows 8 → 9 families.
- No forced edits to existing test rows.

## Acceptance notes

- Price: every card's `--commands` now carries `pnpm check:adr-anchors` (self-test plus scan, about 11 s measured here).
- Serial: PR #34080 (in the merge queue) and card #34084 also edit `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, in other regions; whichever lands second resolves.
- The claim's acceptance line asks for `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr` and the tier; the reading is in the os-dev-report on the card.

## Verification

Local gates on a6876cc8 (main f81e4b6c is the base): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 33 commands; all 33 exit 0. `--ran`: **33 derived, 33 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**. No package touched, so no build closure and no package test is owed; no changeset (`skip-changeset`).
